text:
A metal block of weight W rests on a table. In order to calculate the pressure that the block exerts
on the table, one other quantity must be known.
What is the other quantity?
A
the area of contact between the block and the table
B
the density of the block
C
the mass of the block
D
the volume of the block

options.label: A
options.text: the area of contact between the block and the table
